name: Nairobi
text: Our home base. Every Valcon flight starts at Wilson Airport, minutes from the city centre and the gateway to Kenya's parks and conservancies.

name: Mombasa
text: Kenya's port city on the Indian Ocean, with Old Town, Fort Jesus and the beaches of the north and south coast close by.

name: Nanyuki
text: A highland town on the equator at the foot of Mount Kenya, and the usual way in to the Laikipia conservancies.

name: Kisumu
text: The lakeside city on the Winam Gulf of Lake Victoria, serving western Kenya and the wider lake region.

name: Malindi
text: A relaxed coastal town known for its long beaches, marine park and fishing, a short hop up the coast from Mombasa.

name: Lodwar
text: The main town of Turkana County in the north-west, and the base for trips to Lake Turkana.
